phrases = [
    "Never odd or even",
    "Race a car",
    "Was it a car or a cat I saw?",
    "Hello, World!",
    "Step on no pets.",
    "No lemon, no melon",
]
for phrase in phrases:
    letters = "".join(c for c in phrase.lower() if "a" <= c <= "z")
    result = "yes" if letters == letters[::-1] else "no"
    print(f"{phrase} -> {result}")
